description: Get analyst price target data for a ticker. By default returns the consensus / split-adjusted average price target. Set list=true to return the full per-analyst list of individual price targets instead.

limit.description: Maximum results when list=true (default: 50, max: 100). Ignored for consensus.

list.description: false/omitted = consensus price target; true = per-analyst price-target list

name: get_price_target
title: Get Price Target
